concept: Lambda: provisioned concurrency vs cold starts
tests: Recognizing a cold start and choosing the direct fix for first-request latency.
expected: Provisioned concurrency keeps pre-initialized environments — the first request has no init delay. Triggers: "first request after idle", "high p99 latency", "warm requests are fast", "large dependency package".
why_not: Lowering the timeout does not shorten initialization; reserved concurrency = 0 disables the function; more memory speeds things up slightly but does not pre-warm environments.
